data.one_liner: Calculates real-time mobility features like places, stops, and home stay from location data.
data.what_it_does: Processes location sample streams to compute mobility metrics such as significant places, stops, moves, home stay, location entropy, and distance traveled. It runs as a singleton and relies on an external location plugin for raw GPS data.
use_when: You need to derive real-time mobility analytics and behavioral features from phone location history.
You are already capturing background location updates and want to analyze stops, places, and home stay.
avoid_when: You just need a basic map view or simple geolocation coordinates without analytics.
You cannot guarantee that your app has persistent background location permissions (ALWAYS access).
strengths: Provides complex derived metrics like location entropy and home stay out of the box.
Stream-based architecture integrates cleanly with background location streams.
weaknesses: Does not handle OS location permissions or raw data collection natively; requires a separate location plugin.
Feature calculations can result in fallback values (-1.0) if prerequisites (like nighttime data or minimum places) are not met.
data.setup_notes: Requires an external location plugin (like carp_background_location) to supply location samples, plus explicit OS-level permissions for background location access.
